fact: Recommended as best free Cloudinary alternative (2026-02-02 16:35 UTC): Research identified Cloudflare R2 with 10GB free storage and unlimited free egress bandwidth as optimal choice for image-heavy tour website. Key advantages: global CDN (300+ cities), S3-compatible API for bulk migration, zero bandwidth costs at scale ($0.015/GB storage only), Next.js native loader support.

Blur loading compatibility (2026-02-02 16:35 UTC): Cloudflare Image Transformations via /cdn-cgi/image/ URL parameters provide resize, format conversion, and quality optimization. For blur placeholders, recommended BlurHash approach (30-byte strings stored in Convex) decoded via react-blurhash to replicate Cloudinary's automatic blur feature.
